text_block_list.text:
I'm taking a walk around the academy
grounds to
get some fresh air, when
suddenly...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: BWAAAHAHAHA!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Obnoxiously loud laughter comes out of
nowhere!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Startled, I look every which way, until
finally I
spot the culprit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Well met, traveler.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I am the the lurker in the trees... The
guardian of
this realm.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп suddenly leaps down out of
the
branches. I wonder how long she's
been hiding up
there.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Answer me this, traveler.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Was it a super heavy plate of fake jumbo
shrimp
that you dropped in the forest?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Or was it a feather-light, ultra-fast 7G

smartphone?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I give my pockets a once-over, but
nothing seems
to be missing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oho? Nothing, you say?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Really? Are you absolutely sure?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Get with the program, geez! At least try to play along!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like I can back out of
this one. I'll
go with...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: The super heavy fake jumbo shrimp.

text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! A fine answer, traveler.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
An honest soul such as yourself may take
the
shrimp with you. Wait but a moment.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Nrggh... Hrauggghhh!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: A series of grunts issues from within the trees. That shrimp must be really jumbo.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Was it always this honkin' heavy?
Nrgghh,
hrauggghhh... Uh-oh.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Crap! It's stuck! The shrimp tails got
hitched on
something!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I could've sworn I heard voices. Is
something
going on?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Ah! Ryan! Perfect timing! Gimme a hand
here!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Whew... Thanks. That shrimp nearly
ended up lost
to the trees...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Glad I could help.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But you've gotta train up if you wanna
lift weights
this heavy, or you're just
gonna get yourself hurt.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I know! Why don't we hit the gym
together? Like,
right now?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I can give you pointers on what muscles
to build
up!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
(Urk! Ryan's workouts are a boot camp
from hell!)
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Nah, my muscles aren't really up for
pumping iron
toda―
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
No sweat! I'm the best spotter around!
C'mon,
let's go!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Waaaaaahhh!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Swept up in Мэдзиро Райан's enthusiasm,
Голд Шип
gets whisked off to the gym...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, look at those glutes work! Let's hit
fifty
more reps! Keep up the pace!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Mrrgh! Keep up... the pace!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! A fine answer, traveler.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
An honest soul such as yourself may take
the
ultra-fast 7G smart phone. Here it
comes...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп lifts the phone high over her
head, and
then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Swoosh!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Ultra-fast, no? That's the
speed of
7G! Or seven gazelles, to be
precise.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Better get a move on, or it's going to hit
the
ground.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Belatedly, I realize I'd better start
running. But
just as I set off...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hyooo?! Is that a bird? Is it a plane? No,
it's a
phone... And is that the scent of an
Umamusume I
smell?
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text: Oh crap!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't have used my own phone!
Change of
plans! Trainer, I'm going
all-out!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: If she gets to my phone first, there's no telling what'll happen!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп takes off at breakneck speed
with pure
desperation in her eyes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: HRAAAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: MY PHOOOOONE!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Hyoooueee?! A-an Umamusume's
chasing meee?!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Got it back, safe and sound... And I
learned a
valuable lesson too.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Uhuhu! She caught up to me! That! Was!

Awesome!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
Never hurl your phone into the
stratosphere,
'cause you never know
what kinda weirdo might
be waiting to
catch it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп seems a little more buff than
usual
after the workout... but also a little
exhausted.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
